blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) will begin distributing water filtration kits next week as the country braces for the impact of “Super El Niño.” At a Palace briefing on Wednesday, DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian demonstrated how to install a water filtration system on a bucket. He and Palace press officer Claire Castro also drank the filtered water and vouched for its potability.
